List, follow and configure CircleCI projects

## Usage

`circleci project <command>`

## General Commands

| Command  | Description                          |
| -------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `create` | Create a new project                 |
| `list`   | List followed projects               |
| `open`   | Open the project page in the browser |

## Targeted Commands

| Command  | Description                              |
| -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `follow` | Follow a project                         |
| `get`    | Show project details                     |
| `link`   | Bind this checkout to a CircleCI project |

## Subcommands

| Command   | Description                                            |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `dlc`     | Purge a project's Docker layer cache (DLC)             |
| `envvar`  | List, set and delete a project's environment variables |
| `setting` | View and update project advanced settings              |
| `trigger` | Manage project triggers                                |

## Flags

Global flags: `-c, --config`, `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Details

List, follow, and manage settings for CircleCI projects.

A project corresponds to a version-control repository connected
to CircleCI. Use 'circleci project list' to see all followed projects,
'circleci project follow' to start following a new project, and
'circleci project envvar' to manage environment variables.

To manage environment variables directly, use the top-level alias:
  circleci envvar list --project gh/org/repo
